files.README.md:
# Fenwick Quay Ice Plant - compressor bank

config/compressors.yaml gives one section per compressor, named
compressor_N in bank order. The plate-freezer unit delivered this
week is unit three in the bank, so it enters as compressor_3 with
the same keys as its siblings. Its cutout differs: it serves the
plate freezers and cuts out at -18, not at the chill-store -12.
New units start with service_due_h: 0 and are appended at the end
of the file in the same two-space style; existing sections stay
untouched.

config/compressors.yaml.equals:

  cutout_c: -18

turns.prompt: Fenwick Quay Ice Plant has wired up its new plate-freezer unit.
